blocks.text: Kris Aquino said she would consider pursuing public service if she were healthy, particularly through the Department of Health (DOH) where she hopes to make medicines more affordable and accessible. Kris spoke about this during her television reunion with her close friend and longtime co-host Boy Abunda, as seen on the episode of the latter’s “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” on Wednesday, Oct. 28. The show host asked, “Given the chance and at sa awa ng Diyos na ika’y maging healthy, papasukin mo ang politika?” “Yes,” the Queen of All Media immediately answered, although she noted, “But I’m not healthy.” Kris […]...
